# Workflow Station Guidelines

Human-facing designer, Admin, and Portal guidelines. No login.
Canonical site: /help/ (edge: http://localhost:3000/help/).

Do not invent UI labels. Ground answers in these articles and the screenshots under /help/guides/.

## Index by job

- /help/computed-fields — Computed field formulas (Table Design; Admin Relation Tables #relation)
- /help/email-send — Send email (Connections #connection, Email Templates #template, Send Task #send-task)
- /help/email-monitor — Email Monitor (inbound connection, monitor template, Start Event binding)
- /help/up-tasks-to-claim — To Do: claim pool on the same list; Claim all; Unclaim all (own holds); auto-claim on open (default off); Leader / Approver / SYS_ADMIN force unclaim
